notes: Ports listed are for the base EOS C300 Mark III camera body only. Optional Expansion Units (EU-V1, EU-V2, EU-V3) add further ports not included here: Ethernet, Genlock/Sync Out, RS422 Remote B, two additional XLR audio inputs (4 total), a Lens port, 24V DC output/D-Tap, and V-mount battery power, plus broadcast tally/return connectors on EU-V3. Base-body specs (SDI, HDMI, XLR audio, mic, headphone, timecode, remote, DC IN) were confirmed directly from Canon USA's official product/specifications page and cross-checked against Markertek's retailer listing, which agreed on all details. The USB terminal's connector type/version is not stated by Canon in the spec table and is a best-effort inference (marked with lower confidence). Region variants (e.g. Canon Europe/Japan listings) were not checked but Cinema EOS specs are typically identical worldwide aside from AC plug/voltage labeling, which does not apply here (DC-only power input).

ports.name: SDI OUT
ports.note: Single BNC, output only; supports HD (SMPTE 292) through 12G-SDI (SMPTE ST 2082), enabling 4K up to 60p over one cable

ports.name: HDMI OUT
ports.note: Full-size Type A, output only, up to 4096x2160; Canon's spec sheet does not state an HDMI version number so no grade is set

ports.name: INPUT 1
ports.note: 3-pin XLR; Mic level, Mic level with +48V phantom power, or Line level selectable

ports.name: INPUT 2
ports.note: 3-pin XLR; Mic level, Mic level with +48V phantom power, or Line level selectable

ports.name: TC (Time Code)
ports.note: Single BNC terminal, menu-switchable between timecode input and output (not simultaneous)

ports.name: REMOTE A
ports.note: LANC-compatible / RC-V100 remote terminal. Actual connector is a 2.5mm sub-mini stereo jack; trs-3.5 chosen as closest listed connector

ports.name: DC IN
ports.note: DC IN 12V coaxial power jack, accepts 11.5-20V DC

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Canon's spec sheet lists a USB terminal without stating type/version; USB-C is inferred from the camera's generation/design and is unconfirmed
